thread:
Riya (AE): FYI Triskelion POC started full warmup and were getting intermittent 429s + a few 502s in the last 15m. Customer asking for a short surge guarantee for a go/no-go test tomorrow. opening war-room.
Tom (SE): quick snapshot: token bucket drained during ramp, backend model tail latency spikes when a cold shard is hit. logs:
```
2026-03-21T08:45:11Z INFO req=pt-9 route=/v1/chat model=redwood-13b latency_ms=130
2026-03-21T08:45:12Z WARN upstream=lb status=502 req=pt-10
2026-03-21T08:45:13Z ERROR limiter id=lim-9 tokens=0 allow=false
```
Hannah (oncall): tokens=0 means burst exhausted. Fastest fix: increase per-tenant burst tokens (config change). I can do it if we record the change in an ops ticket.
Riya (AE): customer expects spikes to 400 RPS for <2m during tests. Need a clear price and ETA.
Raj (SalesOps): pricing options: 48h surge addon or one-hour pre-warm dedicated slot. Need estimated tokens/sec to finalize.
Zoe (Security): redact any payloads before sharing traces externally; add SSQ flag for audit log retention and KMS.
Tom (SE): mitigation plan ranked:
- config bump (minutes)
- route warmup traffic to a pre-warmed dedicated instance (30-60m prep)
- client-side smoothing (requires customer changes)
deploy-bot: Change queued: rate_limiter.adjust tenant=triskelion delta=+200 window=120s approver=Hannah (oncall)
Hannah (oncall): applying config now, monitoring here. will keep bump in place for 2h unless we see issues.
Riya (AE): notifying customer were trying a quick config. preparing pricing to send in 30m.
Tom (SE): after bump, 502s dropped, 429s reduced but p99 inference still >2s when a cold shard is used. trace:
```
span=kv_fetch time_ms=380 backend=redis-prod queue=50
span=model_exec time_ms=2200 gpu_wait=1
```
Tom (SE): recommendation: schedule a 30m pre-warm on a dedicated node for their test window tomorrow. avoids cold model tail.
Raj (SalesOps): I'll draft surge and pre-warm pricing: pre-warm hourly at 2.5x dedicated rate, 48h surge addon with capped overage. ETA 30m.
Zoe (Security): if they request Dedicated/Private, start SSQ handoff; I need vendor questionnaire access.
Riya (AE): I'll open SSQ ticket and loop Zoe. Tom, please supply redacted traces and token metrics for the questionnaire.
Hannah (oncall): monitoring set: alert if 5xx > 1% over 5m; reverting config in 2h if stable.
Tom (SE): capturing full traces during next warmup for the postmortem.
Riya (AE): next steps: 1) Hannah keeps burst bump for 2h; 2) Tom schedules pre-warm slot tomorrow 09:30 UTC; 3) Raj sends price within 30m; 4) Riya starts SSQ handoff.
deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-2468 subject="Triskelion POC: warmup spikes" owner=Tom (SE) severity=low
Riya (AE): thanks team, updating customer: quick config applied, pre-warm proposal incoming, SSQ started. continue critical alerts in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
